subject: Post-demo: hosted API token forecast + 99th% TPS follow-up
messages:
From: jasmine_liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@clarionhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: hosted API token forecast + 99th% TPS follow-up

Hi Amit / Priya —

Great to meet this morning. Quick recap from our end and a couple of concrete asks so we can lock a pricing band and SLO: 

Summary from the demo
- Product surface: Clarion will use Redwood Hosted API for clinical summarization + triage prompts (mix of short & long prompts, average request ~550 tokens).
- Expected production cadence: post-demo pilot moving to weekly rollouts across regions in Q3.

Quant (askable) items we scoped on-call
1) Monthly tokens (rough): you mentioned a midline of ~20M but with seasonality. For planning we sketched a band: 15M–25M tokens/mo. Please confirm a realistic target for contract sizing.
2) Peak load (99th percentile TPS): we recorded sustained peaks at ~120 TPS and occasional spikes. Can you confirm the 99th% TPS requirement you need Redwood to design for?
3) Target unit economics: do you have a target $/1M tokens for hosted API (ballpark) that you need us to meet versus a committed discount?

What we can offer (high level)
- Hosted API: predictable per-1M pricing with block discounts for committed monthly anchors.
- Burst allowance: short term spike protection (configurable) — we can size the burst window based on your 99th% TPS target.

Attachments: I attached the traffic sample you shared earlier (clarion-prod-traffic-sample.csv) and our hosted pricing matrix (redwood-hosted-pricing-matrix.pdf) to make the ask concrete.

Next steps
- Amit/Priya: confirm single monthly token target (or a narrow band) + 99th% TPS to design SLOs and a recommended pricing band.
- Karthik/Marissa: we’ll respond with a tight banded quote and burst policy once we get the numbers.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20m call if that’s easier.

— Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
attachments: clarion-prod-traffic-sample.csv, redwood-hosted-pricing-matrix.pdf
From: Amit Shah <amit@clarionhealth.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@clarionhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: hosted API token forecast + 99th% TPS follow-up

Thanks Jasmine — great demo. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Monthly tokens: after talking to the product team we’re more comfortable with a 12M–20M realistic band for Q3 (growth expected, but conservative baseline). The 20M figure is aggressive and contingent on adoption.

2) 99th% TPS: operationally we need the 99th percentile to be protected at 120 TPS. However, our traffic pattern shows micro-bursts up to ~180 TPS that last 3–8 minutes during certain workflows (end-of-day reports). We’d like any SLO/commit to allow safe bursting to those peaks for short windows without throttling user-facing flows.

3) Unit economics: procurement wants a target in the ~$50–$65 per 1M tokens window for hosted (this is a stretch target). If we commit to a 12–18 month anchor we can stretch higher to the lower part of that band.

4) Compliance ask: can you confirm data retention defaults and whether audit logs for inference calls are exported to our tenant (we’ll need this for the security questionnaire).

If you can send 2–3 banded quotes that reflect (a) no commit, (b) 6–12 month anchor, (c) 12–18 month anchor (with burst windows), that’d be perfect.

— Amit
Amit Shah
Director, Product — Clarion Health
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@clarionhealth.com>, Priya Desai <priya@clarionhealth.com>
Cc: jasmine_liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted pricing bands + burst sizing (follow-up)

Hi Amit / Priya — looping in pricing details per Jasmine’s request. Thanks for the clear targets. Below are two succinct options that map to your ask.

Assumptions (from your notes)
- Monthly baseline: 12M–20M tokens (we’ll show bands anchored at 12M, 16M, 20M).
- Average request size: ~550 tokens; burst windows: short bursts up to 180 TPS for 3–10 minutes.
- SLO target: protect 99th percentile without cold-start delays.

Pricing (hosted API, per 1M tokens) — indicative list pricing, final to be set in contract
- On-demand (no commit): $68 / 1M tokens (standard rate).
- 6–12 month anchor (mid): $55 / 1M tokens with a 10% reserved throughput discount and constrained burst pool.
- 12–18 month anchor (highest commit): $45 / 1M tokens with guaranteed burst buffer: up to 2x baseline TPS for sustained 10-minute windows and automated fallback to a compatible quantized variant if capacity constrained.

Burst policy (practical)
- We can guarantee the 99th percentile at 120 TPS under the 12–18 month anchor.
- For the micro-bursts to 180 TPS: we can provide a burst buffer that allows short windows (3–10 minutes) with no throttling, but sustained high-frequency spikes will be charged as overage or require an elevated baseline in the contract.

Compliance & retention
- By default Redwood Hosted keeps inference logs for 30 days; we offer enterprise retention add-ons (90/365 days) and can stream audit logs to your tenant (S3 or partner SIEM) per an amended SOC2/contractual scope.

Attachments: included a compact pricing PDF (redwood-hosted-pricing-matrix.pdf) that lays out the bands and burst examples.

Next steps
1) If the 12–18 month anchor at $45 / 1M hits your target, we can draft a term sheet and scope the burst SLA.
2) If you prefer the mid anchor, we’ll prepare a 6–12 month quote with limited burst coverage and a short pilot addendum.

I’m available Monday for a quick sync to finalize which band to push to legal.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Hosted pricing bands + burst sizing (follow-up)

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Karthik.

We’re leaning to the 12–18 month anchor at $45 / 1M — that’s close to procurement’s upper stretch and makes the burst SLA easier for our product team. Two quick asks before we accept:
1) Can you add a line item that clarifies overage billing rules for repeated daily bursts (we want predictability if we exceed the burst buffer three days in a row).
2) Please confirm retention tiers and the mechanism to export audit logs to our S3 (Priya will validate with security).

If you can send a short term sheet with those two clarifications, we’ll route to procurement and aim to sign within two weeks. Also cc’ing Marissa to coordinate the term sheet and next steps.

Thanks — Amit
